analysis:
The only change in this PR is a test-only addition at head lines 625-634 of MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineTests.swift: gptOssStopStringsAreScopedToTheFinalChannel. It asserts that ModelEOSPolicy.stopStringScope returns a CBv2StopStringScope (opener "<|channel|>final", openerEnd "<|message|>", closers end/return/call/start) for gpt-oss model IDs or model_type gpt_oss, and nil for gemma-4 and qwen models. No production code is in the supplied diff, so no change to trust boundaries, authorization, attestation, encryption, the prefix-cache storage (T-041), billing or availability is visible. The head and base files are otherwise identical, apart from line renumbering after the insertion. The test helpers (Counter, gate, engine, tokenizer) are unchanged.

Unverified contract: the production ModelEOSPolicy.stopStringScope and the CBv2 stop-string scoping behavior are outside the supplied evidence. They are presumably changed in other files or batches. A later pass should check that scoping client stop strings to the Harmony final channel does not let stop strings truncate or leak analysis-channel content. It should also check that it does not alter token or billing accounting and that tool-call (<|call|>) handling stays correct. This is a test-only unit and I make no claim about the production logic.
